content_text: Very well thought out article that I recommend giving a read Have personally spent a lot of time thinking through how AI will impact public market investing The reality is that if everyone uses AI to beat the market, the alpha erodes away on its own The reflexivity of the market is a beautiful thing that prevents alpha from lying around for too long Just like any other software vendor or platform that was used before, AI will become a tool to enhance analyst work. I doubt it will ever fully replace them
